about: Floods series d3: the close-up boxes of the two sets. `at` is the box's center (lon, lat); each area's boxes are `size` SVG units (Shockoe 340 by 165, 170 m across at the plate's scale of 2; Manchester 320 by 320), shaped to the sheet's cells. Shockoe boxes are drawn for Agnes 1972 beside its dry twin; Manchester boxes for the 1972 height against today's wall beside the same without the wall. Notes are one line each, from the series' research (drafts/richmond-floods/casestudy/2026-11-23-02-research-river-floods-and-the-wall/) and the floods log. rc1: the station's box moved 120 m to show its south end and shed beside I-95 (in d3 the viaduct filled it); Mayo Island (two buildings and a parking lot) replaced by the canal at Virginia and Byrd streets, where the riverfront meets the north wall's west end (Tobacco Row at 22nd and 23rd was tried: dry at its center in every flood but 1972); the across-floods strips take every Shockoe flood, Fran and 2020 with the wall. Notes and their sources are in drafts/richmond-floods/notes.json. rc1 fix round: the canal box moved 30 m west, clear of the wall's label; the market box 20 m east, so Gaston's pin A falls inside it. rc2: Shockoe boxes are 300 by 149 units (150 m across), untangled: box 2 moved 28 m west so no frame or badge falls in another; boxes 1 to 3 give their depth at the named gauge place inside them (`depthAt`, `depthName`), so one place has one number. `lists`: the Gaston sheet's own boxes (places with water or a named report) and the with-wall sheets' (1996, 2020), 300 by 111 (a three-column layout). rc2 fix: box 1 moved 33 m nearer so the 17th and Main gauge sits inside it; Gaston's boxes 260 units across, box 3 centered between pins D and E.
